title: 2546. Apply Bitwise Operations to Make Strings Equal

examples.explanation: We can do the following operations: - Choose i = 2 and j = 0. We have now s = "0010". - Choose i = 2 and j = 1. We have now s = "0110". Since we can make s equal to target, we return true.
It is not possible to make s equal to target with any number of operations.
